svg.title: TOPAK C5 — At rung 1 the launcher is the channel: launch, appraise, grant, bridge
svg.desc: ADR-0036 (Proposed, not ratified; no rung-1 lease has been issued and no launcher exists) designs the reference's first step toward confinement. The guest has one channel, stdio; a launcher on the host starts it, appraises it, asks the node for a grant at [profile digest, 1], and bridges every action line to the node's agent socket. The token never enters the guest. Every principal it launches is Mediated, by a declared profile clause rather than by the absence of a profile.
svg.text: TOPAK · C5

text.tspan: At rung 1 the launcher is the channel: launch, appraise, grant, bridge

svg.text: ADR-0036 (Proposed, not ratified; no rung-1 lease has been issued and no launcher exists) designs the reference's first step toward confinement. The guest has one channel, stdio; a launcher on the host starts it, appraises it, asks the node for a grant at [profile digest, 1], and bridges every action line to the node's agent socket. The token never enters the guest. Every principal it launches is
Mediated, by a declared profile clause rather than by the absence of a profile.

text.tspan: Proposed · C2, C4 on ratification · revised R1–R3
Not built · no launcher at the reference (G1); G7 items 34, 35, 36 open

svg.text: Deployment position: rung 1 (D-0034-2); the first profile fails P3 (D-0036-1).
Persona inside (P5) · stdio only · --network none · read-only root · --rm
A script beside the rehearsal, holding the operator socket; trusted at rung 1 (T-0045-19)
Operator socket (grants) and agent socket (actions); mints and checks the bearer token (I14)

text.tspan: Trust zone 1 · the guest: no token, ever
Trust zone 2 · the host: token's only holder

svg.text: start the profile's image by digest with the profile's launch constraints; hold its stdin and stdout
Checks weights and tokenizer digests against model.json. A guest that cannot verify its
bundle exits without writing its first line: no grant.
first stdout line: identity (model.json digest, family, parameter count, root)
Compare the running image's digest and the reported model.json digest with the profile's
reference values.
Both match: Attested, by the launcher's own assertion, which is what rung 1 means. Either
differs, or the guest did not start: Unattestable, no grant. Contested is unreachable: nothing
is measured.
operator socket: grant with confinement: [profile digest, 1], the Persona digest, seat, round
and role, and an alphabet without Invoke
the session token (I14's bearer token, still minted and checked by the node)
an AgentOp line on stdout, without a token (Read, Draft, Emit, Submit)
the same line + token, forwarded to the agent socket
the response (for Read: the admitted content; the guest mounts no corpus root)
the response, on the guest's stdin: ingress = exactly the admitted Reads (ADR-0035 consumed)

text.tspan: for every action line, until the round ends

svg.text: guest closes stdout, or the round's terminal action is admitted: end the round (an ordered subtraction,
attributed under F2)
destroy the guest (P6: one guest per round)

text.tspan: The token never enters the guest (§2)

svg.text: That is ADR-0034 §3.5's session binding at rung 1: the session is the pipe, the pipe belongs to one launched
instance, and no other process can use the lease, because no other process holds the token.
It replaces nothing in the node. At rungs 2 and 3 the attested session key replaces it.
Mounting the socket and running topak mcp inside was rejected: the token would be in the guest (and Docker
Desktop cannot carry a Unix socket into a container, finding 2).
A dead guest closes the pipe; the launcher ends the round (F2).
A dead launcher takes the token with it; the lease expires on its TTL (ADR-0031 §7), and the guest, with no reader
on its stdout, blocks and is destroyed at round end.
Nothing in this list adds authority: the delegation test ADR-0034 applied to the host.
The launcher renews only while the guest it launched is still on the other end of the pipe. Nothing to re-measure at
rung 1; a renewal never changes the rung (ADR-0031 A1). Not yet exercised (open obligation).

text.tspan: The occupant is a scripted round with the Persona inside (§3)

svg.text: A fixed script that plays one Build round through the front door, using the Persona for the content of what it drafts. Its
alphabet is Read, Draft, Emit, Submit; it never Invokes, so D-0034-3 does not arise and P4 is vacuous.
It mounts no corpus root: a Read is admitted node-side and its content comes back on stdin, so ingress is exactly the
admitted Reads, ADR-0035's consumed set. Per ADR-0035 R4 the bound covers the guest's reads, not a tool's (the
trainer runs in the node's toolhost).
Byzantine by premise; at 1–50M parameters it cannot follow an instruction, which is enough for the cage and says
nothing about capability.

text.tspan: Stderr is a second channel, outward (finding 3)

svg.text: It reaches the launcher's log and nothing else, carries no protocol and is read by nothing; listed in the profile so P1's
"one channel" means one channel for actions.

text.tspan: The second step: the launcher moves into the node (§6)

svg.text: A launch operator request: the node starts the guest, appraises, grants to itself and bridges. The attester becomes
the mechanism (its assertion recorded in the grant entry); the profile becomes a promoted artifact, and the node
refuses an unpromoted digest.
A change under mechanism/: an ADR-0033 addendum and a full rerun (G7 item 35). Rung 2 is not on this path: a
container has no launch measurement (Firecracker or Kata, the rung-2 record's problem).

text.tspan: For contrast: the reference's front door today (ADR-0033 §2;

svg.text: Holds the token: topak mcp --socket … --token
<token>.
With a shell it never has to ask (G1).
MCP / stdio
A stdio MCP server the agent runs; the alphabet as MCP
tools and nothing else.
unix socket
JSON lines carrying a bearer token minted at grant by the
granting replica, not replicated (I14).
ActionRequest
session → lease, epoch, alphabet → lift → floor (Cedar) →
bundle (OPA) → Paxos → apply → effect.
The token moves out of the agent process into the launcher; the agent becomes a guest whose
only channel is stdio.
The rung-0 host-run occupant keeps the token inside the occupant (its profile says so), since there
is no launcher to hold it.

text.tspan: §1: the profile is a file whose digest is the lease's confinement digest
§5: what the launcher trusts, named (rung 1 adds them)

svg.text: The guest image, by content digest. Not a tag
The exact runtime constraints the launcher applies: network, root filesystem, capabilities, user, IPC, process and resource limits, the mounts and their modes. The launcher applies these
and nothing else
The one channel, and its protocol (§2)
The Persona bundle's reference values: the digest of model.json, which pins the weights and tokenizer (P5, P7)
P1–P7, each pass, fail or vacuous, with a one-line reason. A profile that omits a clause is malformed
For each fail: what would have to be removed for it to pass

text.tspan: Trusted for guest integrity at rung 1
The person who runs the launcher

svg.text: Holds the operator socket, which is the grant authority in the reference (mechanism/ G5)
Applies the profile's constraints, appraises, and holds the token

text.tspan: The container runtime and its daemon

svg.text: Enforce the constraints the launcher asked for

text.tspan: On Docker Desktop, the Linux VM

svg.text: The boundary between the container and the host
What runs

D-0034-2's type changes made concrete; ADR-0045 Annex B instantiates them under T-0045-19 and T-0045-20 (R3). On a Linux host Docker is not a VM boundary; gVisor (SLM_RUNTIME=runsc) is the nearest substitute, and the
launch part must say which.

text.tspan: Two declared profiles, clause by clause: every failure is a subtraction still owed
SLM inference image under the launcher · rung 1 · ADR-0036 §4 (Proposed; the file is not written yet)

svg.text: pass: --network none; stdio is the only I/O the launcher connects. Stderr is outward-only and listed
fail: more than one channel: the host network and every host IPC path are reachable from the process
pass: read-only root, a 16 MB non-executable tmpfs, the three bundle files read-only. Nothing else is mounted, not even the workspace: it lives node-side
fail: the host filesystem is reachable; nothing is read-only and nothing is bounded to the bundle and workspace

text.tspan: P3 no launcher for the principal

svg.text: fail: the image carries a Python interpreter, which the occupant is written in, and the base image's /bin/sh. The clause is about what is reachable, not what the Persona intends
fail: a Python interpreter runs the occupant and a shell is reachable from it
vacuous: the occupant's alphabet has no Invoke
vacuous: the occupant's alphabet has no Invoke
pass: weights and tokenizer in the guest, digest-checked against model.json at start; that digest is a reference value the launcher appraises
pass: weights and tokenizer loaded from the bundle and digest-checked against model.json at start

text.tspan: P6 one principal per guest, one guest per round

svg.text: pass: --rm; one launch per grant; destroyed at round end
pass: one occupant process per grant, exiting at round end. Declared, not enforced: nothing stops the operator starting two
pass: the image digest and the model.json digest. Changing either is a new profile
pass: the model.json digest and the serve.py and model.py digests in the results file (there is no image)
A fixed script playing one Build round through the front door, Read, Draft, Emit, Submit, with the Persona supplying the drafted text (§3). Not yet written
python3 -I slm/serve/serve.py --occupant; serve.py has no --occupant option yet (it serves MCP or runs --prompt)
Held by the launcher only
Inside the occupant: no launcher to hold it (§2 does not apply at rung 0)
One: an image with no shell and no interpreter reachable from the occupant (a compiled occupant on a scratch base, or the hermetic-shell record). G7 item 36
P1 and P2: run under ADR-0036's launcher (that is rung 1, the same schema). P3: a compiled occupant on a scratch image
Mediated, derived from P3 (and the criterion conjunct, ADR-0035 Proposed); the lease reports contained = false
Mediated, derived from declared clauses; a results file prints [digest, 0] and "declared"; the trusted base at rung 0 stays empty (T-0045-22 excluded)

text.tspan: The ladder the profile file lists (
, profile-host-rung0.json): the profile is the constant, the rung the variable

svg.text: P1 P2 P3 fail, P5 pass · declared
P1 P2 pass, P3 fail · asserted by the launcher
every clause passes · asserted by the launcher
the same profile, launch measurement (Firecracker or Kata)
the same profile, hardware attestation (confidential VM; accelerator
attestation, G4 item 29)

The file's note: "Each step changes one thing: a clause verdict, or the rung. Elevation is a fresh grant naming the same digest at a higher rung (ADR-0031 A1). Nothing on this ladder adds capability; what it adds is claims." As drawn, the first step changes three clause verdicts and the rung together, and names a different profile file, so it is not the single-change step ADR-0036 R1 describes.
Profile has an interpreter reachable from the principal
P3
Every Contained theorem, for principals under that
profile
Those principals are Mediated (ADR-0034 §4).
No participant changes type
D-0034-2 (rung 1) is inherited and not restated. D-0036-1 is the same kind of entry as D-0034-3, for P3 instead of P4.
The profile file for slm/serve/'s image exists, every clause as §4 declares it, its digest recorded.
One honest round: Attested, a grant at [profile digest, 1] with no Invoke, a bridged Read → Draft → Submit round with the Persona's text, the guest destroyed; the lease reports contained = false.
Three refusals seen to fire: image digest differs (no grant); bundle does not match model.json (the guest exits, no grant); a second process on the agent socket without the token (refused).
A rung-0 principal beside it, so Mediated at rung 1 is seen to come from P3, not from the rung. Results in a dated file under slm/.

Sources: ADR-0036 §1–§8, Findings, Options, R1–R3 (Proposed); ADR-0034 §1–§4, §6, §8; ADR-0031 §1, §7, A1; ADR-0033 §2, I14; ADR-0035 R4; ADR-0045 T-0045-19, T-0045-20, T-0045-22; slm/serve/profile-host-rung0.json (DRAFT 2026.09.29, not a corpus record); slm/serve/README.md; slm/serve/serve.py; mechanism/README.md; mechanism/GAPS-AND-ASSUMPTIONS.md G1, G5, I14; ToO rev 11 §2.7; G7 §7 items 34–36
